info.note: This encoder really creates XOR repair packets over random source subsets. Decoding is done by a peeling decoder. It is Raptor-like / LT-style, not standardized RaptorQ.
Decoder uses real peeling over received repair equations. Full recovery depends on equation graph structure, not only on the number of received packets.
